C1837.title: Freight Boss Sentenced to Three Years for Splitting and Inflating Orders to Defraud Subsidies
C1837.summary: Defendant Zhang ran a freight business and franchised with a Suzhou logistics headquarters, managing its Hefei J27 branch. From December 2019 to April 2020, Zhang secretly split orders and inflated delivery distances to exploit the headquarters' settlement rule (20 yuan per order within 30 km, 2.5 yuan per km beyond), defrauding subsidies. The headquarters discovered the anomaly through profitability audits. In March 2022, Shouxian Court sentenced Zhang to three years' imprisonment (suspended four years) for fraud, with a 100,000 yuan fine and restitution ordered.
